JeremyCox## Jeremy Cox
### Tenure
2007– Present
### Title
Staff Designer
**Jeremy Cox**is a Mattel employee who has worked with Hot Wheels since 2007 as a Project Design Lead and since 2018 as a Staff Designer. Cox specializes in graphic design, and works on the graphics for theHot Wheels Monster Trucksline among others; he also serves as a Creative Director of the Monster Trucks line. Prior to working at Mattel he was a graphic designer for numerous other companies, such as RC2, JMP Creative, VSI Products and Thrill Ride Sports.
